editorial:
Imagine living a completely quiet life, hiding from a past you regret, only to have your world flipped upside down in a single day. You get to follow a stoic man who has spent years acting like a monk to forget his old crimes. Everything changes when he finds out his son was killed in a bad drug deal, and suddenly, there is a little girl in the picture. This granddaughter is the only family he has left, and she is the spark that brings out his protective side. The vibe is a mix of a sad family story and a gritty crime thriller that keeps you wondering just how dangerous the main character really was.

The acting is top-notch, especially the way the lead shows emotion without saying much. The action scenes are punchy and realistic, though the middle of the story drags a bit. If you like stories about old pros coming out of retirement to protect their kids, you will love this. It is a solid pick for a weekend watch.
endingExplained: After a final showdown with the drug dealers who killed his son, the grandfather manages to take down the gang leader in a brutal fight. He makes sure his granddaughter is safe and far away from the violence. Instead of going back to his lonely life, he decides to stop hiding. He chooses to raise the girl as her guardian, finally finding a way to make up for his past mistakes by being a good father figure.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves revenge stories with a lot of heart.
